content.query:
SELECT

AAS.ACID

,AAS.BANK_ID

,AAS.CUST_ID --CUSTOMER_DIM.CORE_CUST_ID

,AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE --M: Main, J: Join, A: Authorized Signatory

,LAM.*

FROM eds.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN AAS

JOIN eds.LNS_LAACCTMAST LAM

ON AAS.ACID = LAM.ACID

AND AAS.BANK_ID = LAM.BANK_ID

AND AAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN LAM.SCD_START_DATE AND LAM.SCD_END_DATE
